title: Ziyarat of Imam Ali on 27 Rajab
intro: The visitation of Imam Ali associated with the night and day of Mabath, 27 Rajab.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Ali on 27 Rajab with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
The ziyarah has been mentioned by Shaykh al-Mufid, Sayyid Ibn Tawus, and al-Shahid in the following form:

When you intend to visit the holy shrine of Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) on the Divine Mission Day or the night before it, you may stop at the gate of the holy dome, facing the holy tomb, and say the following:

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ خَلِيفَةِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama khalifati allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam the vicegerent of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ صِفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin sifwati allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah the choice of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham the intimate friend of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Moses the spoken by Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Jesus the spirit of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ رُسُلِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha muhammadin sayyidi rusuli allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Muhammad the chief of Allah’s Messengers.
Peace be upon you, O commander of the faithful.
Peace be upon you, O epitome of the pious ones.
Peace be upon you, O chief of the Prophets’ successors.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَصِيَّ رَسُولِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya wasiyya rasuli rabbi al`alamina
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O successor of the Messenger of the Lord of the worlds.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِلْمِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O inheritor of the knowledge of the past and the coming generations.
Peace be upon you, O Great News.
Peace be upon you, O Straight Path.
Peace be upon you, O noble, refined one.
Peace be upon you, O pious successor (of the Prophet).
Peace be upon you, O well-pleased, pure one.
Peace be upon you, O shining full moon.
Peace be upon you, O grandest veracious one.
Peace be upon you, O greatest distinguisher (between the right and the wrong).
Peace be upon you, O glowing lantern.
Peace be upon you, O leader to the true guidance.
Peace be upon you, O pattern of piety.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O grand argument of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَاصَّةَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَالِصَتَهُ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khassata allahi wa khalisatahu
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O select and elite of Allah,
trustee and choice of Allah,
door to and argument of Allah,

blocks.transliteration: wa ma`dina hukmi allahi wa sirrahu
blocks.english: source and secret of Allah’s judgment,
guardian and keeper of Allah’s knowledge,
and envoy of Allah among His creatures.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
paid the zakat,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,
followed the Messenger,
recited the Book as exactly as it must be recited,
conveyed the messages of Allah,
fulfilled your covenant with Allah,
the Words of Allah were accomplished by you,

blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
blocks.english: strove in Allah’s way in the best manner,

blocks.arabic: وَنَصَحْتَ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa nasahta lillahi wa lirasulihi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: advised for the sake of Allah and for the sake of His Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household,
and sacrificed yourself with steadfastness, seeking Allah’s reward,
struggling for the defense of Allah’s religion,

blocks.arabic: مُوَقِّياً لِرَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: muwaqqiyan lirasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: protecting Allah’s Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household,
seeking for that which is with Allah,
and desiring for that which Allah has promised.
You also sealed your life as martyr,
a witness, and witnessed;
so, may Allah reward you
on behalf of His Messenger, Islam, and the people of Islam
with the most favorite reward, for you are veracious.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ كُنْتَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْقَوْمِ إِسْلاَماً
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka kunta awwala alqawmi islaman
blocks.english: I bear witness that you were the first to embrace Islam,
the most sincere in faith,
the most confident,
and you were the most Allah-fearing,
the most steadfast (against ordeals for the sake of Islam),

blocks.arabic: وَأَحْوَطَهُمْ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ahwatahum `ala rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: the most watchful for Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household,
endowed with the most favorable merits,
the foremost of everyone else in everything,
the owner of the most elevated rank,
the owner of the most honorable position,
and the most respected (by Almighty Allah and His Messenger).
Thus, you became stronger when they became weak

blocks.arabic: وَلَزِمْتَ مِنْهَاجَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa lazimta minhaja rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: and you abode by the course of Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka kunta khalifatahu haqqan
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you were the true vicegerent of him (i.e. the Holy Prophet);
no one could ever compete with you in this position in spite of the existence of hypocrites,
the despise of the unbelievers,
and the malice of the wicked.
You also managed the matters when they failed to do so,
you spoke (the truth) when they stammered,

blocks.transliteration: wa madayta binuri allahi idh waqafu
blocks.english: and you carried on with the light of Allah when they stopped.
Hence, he who follows you has actually been led to the true guidance.
You were the first to speak,
the firmest in refuting the rivals,
the most eloquent of them,
the most apposite in opinions,
the most courageous,
the most confident of them,
the best of them in deeds,
and the most learned in affairs.
For the believers, you were merciful father,
and they were thus your dependants;
so, you carried the burdens that they were too weak to carry,
preserved that which they forfeited,
conserved that which they neglected,
prepared yourself for facing that which they were too coward to face,
advanced when they were dismayed,
and acted steadfastly when they became anxious.
You were thus incessant torment on the unbelievers,
and you were also rude and furious (on them).

blocks.transliteration: wa lilmu'minina ghaythan wa khisban wa `ilman
blocks.english: You rained (with mercy) on the believers, and you were fertile and source of knowledge for them.
Your argument was never weak,
your heart never deviated,
your sagacity was never feeble,
and your determination never cowered.
You were as firm as mountain, since storms could never displace you
and misfortunes could never move you.

blocks.arabic: كُنْتَ كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: kunta kama qala rasulu allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: You were as exactly as described by Allah’s Messenger—peace be upon him and his Household—who said about you
that you are strong in your body,
modest in yourself,
great in the view of Allah,
imposing in the earth,
and lofty in the heavens.
None could ever find fault with you,
none could ever speak evil of you,
you never desired for any of the created beings,
and you were never lenient (unfairly) to anyone.

blocks.arabic: يُوجَدُ ٱلضَّعِيفُ ٱلذَّلِيلُ عِنْدَكَ قَوِيّاً عَزِيزاً حَتَّىٰ تَأْخُذَ لَهُ بِحَقِّهِ
blocks.transliteration: yujadu aldda`ifu aldhdhalilu `indaka qawiyyan `azizan hatta ta'khudha lahu bihaqqihi
blocks.english: The weak, humble one was strong and mighty in your view until you give him back his right,

blocks.arabic: وَٱلْقَوِيُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ عِنْدَكَ ضَعِيفاً حَتَّىٰ تَأْخُذَ مِنْهُ ٱلْحَقَّ
blocks.transliteration: walqawiyyu al`azizu `indaka da`ifan hatta ta'khudha minhu alhaqqa
blocks.english: and the strong, mighty one was weak in your view until you take the others’ rights from him.

blocks.arabic: الْقَرِيبُ وَٱلْبَعِيدُ عِنْدَكَ فِي ذٰلِكَ سَوَاءٌ
blocks.english: The near and the remote were equal in your view.
Your habit was to be true, honest, and kind,
your words were ruling and determination,
your custom was forbearance and fortitude,
and your view was knowledge and firmness.
At your hands, the religion became even,
the difficult became easy,
the fires were extinguished,
the faith became strong,
Islam became steady,
and the calamity of losing you undermined all people.

blocks.transliteration: fa'inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una
blocks.english: Surely, we are Allah's and to Him we shall surely return.
Curse of Allah be upon him who slew you,
curse of Allah be upon him who mutinied against you,
curse of Allah be upon him who forged lies against you,

blocks.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ ظَلَمَكَ وَغَصَبَكَ حَقَّكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man zalamaka wa ghasabaka haqqaka
blocks.english: curse of Allah be upon him who wronged you and usurped your right,

blocks.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ ذٰلِكَ فَرَضِيَ بِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man balaghahu dhalika faradiya bihi
blocks.english: and curse of Allah be upon him who, when was informed about this, was pleased with it.
Verily, we disavow all those before Allah.
Curse of Allah be upon the group that disagreed with you,
denied your (Divinely commissioned) leadership,
aided each other against you, slew you,
deviated from you, and disappointed you.

blocks.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلنَّارَ مَثْوَاهُمْ
blocks.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi ja`ala alnnara mathwahum
blocks.english: All praise be to Allah, for Hellfire is the abode of those
and evil the place to which they are brought.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ لَكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَوَلِيَّ رَسُولِهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِٱلْبَلاَغِ وَٱلأَدَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu laka ya waliyya allahi wa waliyya rasulihi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi bilbalaghi wal-ada'i
blocks.english: I bear witness for you, O Intimate servant of Allah and loyalist of Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household, that you did convey and carry out (your mission).

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka habibu allahi wa babuhu
blocks.english: And I bear witness that you are the beloved of Allah and the door to Him,

blocks.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ جَنْبُ ٱللَّهِ وَوَجْهُهُ ٱلَّذِي مِنْهُ يُؤْتَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: wa annaka janbu allahi wa wajhuhu alladhi minhu yu'ta
blocks.english: you are the Side of Allah and His Face from which one can come to Allah,
you are Allah’s way,
you are Allah’s servant,

blocks.arabic: وَأَخُو رَسُولِهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa akhu rasulihi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
blocks.english: and you are the brother of His Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household.

blocks.arabic: أَتَيْتُكَ زَائِراً لِعَظِيمِ حَالِكَ وَمَنْزِلَتِكَ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ رَسُولِهِ
blocks.transliteration: ataytuka za'iran li`azimi halika wa manzilatika `inda allahi wa `inda rasulihi
blocks.english: I have thus come to visit you because you enjoy a magnificent position and standing with Allah and with His Messenger.
So, I seek nearness to Allah through my visit to you
and I desire that you will intercede for me.
Through your intercession for me, I hope for redemption of myself,
I seek refuge with you against Hellfire,

blocks.arabic: هَارِباً مِنْ ذُنُوبِيَ ٱلَّتِي ٱحْتَطَبْتُهَا عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِي
blocks.transliteration: hariban min dhunubiya allati ihtatabtuha `ala zahri
blocks.english: I am fleeing from my sins that I have overburdened myself with them,
and I resort to you in the hope of my Lord’s mercy.

blocks.arabic: أَتَيْتُكَ أَسْتَشْفِعُ بِكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: ataytuka astashfi`u bika ya mawlaya ila allahi
blocks.english: I have come to you, O my master, seeking your intercession for me before Allah

blocks.arabic: وَأَتَقَرَّبُ بِكَ إِلَيْهِ لِيَقْضِيَ بِكَ حَوَائِجِي
blocks.transliteration: wa ataqarrabu bika ilayhi liyaqdiya bika hawa'iji
blocks.english: and seeking nearness to Him through you so that He may settle my needs;
so, (please) intercede for me, O Commander of the Faithful.

blocks.transliteration: fa'inni `abdu allahi wa mawlaka wa za'iruka
blocks.english: Verily, I am the slave of Allah and your servant and visitor,
and you enjoy a distinguished position with Allah,
a great rank,
a big standing,
and an admitted right of intercession.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and send blessings upon Your servant, Your most faithful trustee,
Your firmest handle,
Your highest Hand,
Your excellent Word,
Your argument on the people,
Your grandest veracious one,
the chief of the Prophets’ successors,
the reliance of the saints,
the support of the elite ones,
the commander of the faithful,
the leader of the pious ones,
the example of the veracious ones,
the pattern of the righteous ones,
the one protected against flaws,
the one saved from defects,
the one cleared from faults,
the one purified from doubts,
the brother of Your Prophet,
the successor of Your Messenger,
the one who replaced him when he spent that night instead of him,
the one who sacrificed his soul for him,
the one who always relieved him in harsh situations,
and the one whom You chose to be the sword of his (i.e. the Prophet) Prophethood,
the miracle of his (Divine) mission,
the lucid indication of his arguments,
the bearer of his pennon,
the protector of his soul,
the guide of his nation,
the power of his might,
the crown of his head,
the door to his victory,
and the key to his triumph,
until he defeated the armies of polytheism by Your aid,
terminated the warriors of atheism by Your permission,

blocks.arabic: وَبَذَلَ نَفْسَهُ فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ وَمَرْضَاةِ رَسُولِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa badhala nafsahu fi mardatika wa mardati rasulika
blocks.english: exerted all efforts to win the pleasure of You and Your Messenger,
devoted all of his efforts to the obedience to him,
and made of himself armor to protect him from any misfortune,

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ فَاضَتْ نَفْسُهُ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي كَفِّهِ
blocks.transliteration: hatta fadat nafsuhu salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi fi kaffihi
blocks.english: until the soul of the Prophet, peace be upon him and his Household, departed his body while his face was in the hand of `Ali,
who thus felt its coldness,
and rubbed his face therewith.

blocks.transliteration: wa a`anat-hu mala'ikatuka `ala ghuslihi wa tajhizihi
blocks.english: And Your angels helped him bathe and prepare his body for burial.
He then performed [the ritual] prayer for him, buried his body,
settled his debts,
fulfilled his promises,
made his covenants,
followed his example,
and abode by his will.

blocks.arabic: وَحِينَ وَجَدَ أَنْصَاراً نَهَضَ مُسْتَقِلاًّ بِأَعْبَاءِ ٱلْخِلاَفَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa hina wajada ansaran nahada mustaqillan bi'a`ba'i alkhilafati
blocks.english: When he could find supporters, he undertook the burdens of the position of leadership (caliphate)
and assumed the loads of Imamate.
He thus hoisted the flag of true guidance among Your servants,

blocks.transliteration: wa nashara thawba al-amni fi biladika
blocks.english: spread the dress of security in Your lands,
extended justice among Your creatures,
judged according to Your Book among your beings,
executed the laws,
suppressed unbelief,
rectified the deviation,
mollified the criticism,
eradicated lethargy,
blocked the gap,
killed the preachers, the wrongdoers, and the apostates,

blocks.arabic: وَلَمْ يَزَلْ عَلَىٰ مِنْهَاجِ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَوَتِيرَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa lam yazal `ala minhaji rasuli allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa watiratihi
blocks.english: kept on following the course and tradition of Allah’s Messenger, peace be upon him and his Household,
kept on following his excellent pattern,
kept on following his superb practice,
he imitated his convention,
held fast to his morale,
and copied his way (of treating with matters).
And he always noticed the Prophet’s deeds as if they were before his eyes;
he thus ordered Your servants to copy these deeds
and invited them to imitate them

blocks.arabic: إِلَىٰ أَنْ خُضِبَتْ شَيْبَتُهُ مِنْ دَمِ رَأْسِهِ
blocks.transliteration: ila an khudibat shaybatuhu min dami ra'sihi
blocks.english: until his white beard was dyed with the blood of his head.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا لَمْ يُؤْثِرْ فِي طَاعَتِكَ شَكّاً عَلَىٰ يَقِينٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma fakama lam yu'thir fi ta`atika shakkan `ala yaqinin
blocks.english: O Allah, as he never preferred a dubious matter to a certain one for the sake of obeying You
and never associated any one with You even for a winking of an eye,
please send upon him growing and increasing blessings

blocks.arabic: يَلْحَقُ بِهَا دَرَجَةَ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ فِي جَنَّتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: yalhaqu biha darajata alnnubuwwati fi jannatika
blocks.english: due to which he may join the position of Prophethood in Your Paradise,

blocks.transliteration: wa ballighhu minna tahiyyatan wa salaman
blocks.english: and (please) convey our greetings and compliments to him

blocks.arabic: وَآتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فِي مُوَالاَتِهِ فَضْلاً وَإِحْسَاناً
blocks.transliteration: wa atina min ladunka fi muwalatihi fadlan wa ihsanan
blocks.english: and, on account of our allegiance to his leadership, please grant us from You favor, kindness,
forgiveness, and pleasure.
You are verily the Lord of enormous favor.
[please do that] in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

blocks.text:
You may then put your right and then left cheeks on the tomb, turn to the kiblah direction, offer the Prayer of Ziyarah, and supplicate for anything you want.

Then, you may recite the (famous) Tasbih al-Zahra' and say the following:

blocks.english: O Allah, You have conveyed to me glad tidings
through Your Prophet and Messenger
Muhammad, Your peace be upon him and his Household,

blocks.arabic: فَقُلْتَ: «وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوٱ أَنَّ لَهُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ.»
blocks.transliteration: faqulta wa bashshir alladhina amanu anna lahum qadama sidqin `inda rabbihim
blocks.english: as You said, “And give good news to those who believe that theirs is a footing of firmness with their Lord.”

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَإِنِّي مُؤْمِنٌ بِجَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma wa inni mu'minun bijami`i anbiya'ika wa rusulika salawatuka `alayhim
blocks.english: O Allah, I indeed believe in all Your Prophets and Messengers, Your blessings be upon them.
So, (please) do not cause me, after my recognition of them, to be in a situation
due to which You expose me in the presence of the Witnesses;

blocks.arabic: بَلْ قِفْنِي مَعَهُمْ وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَىٰ ٱلتَّصْدِيقِ بِهِمْ
blocks.transliteration: bal qifni ma`ahum wa tawaffani `ala alttasdiqi bihim
blocks.english: rather, (please) include me with them and make me die while I give them credence.
O Allah, You have also bestowed upon them exclusive honor from You
and You have ordered me to follow them.
O Allah, I am Your slave and visitor,
seeking Your nearness through visiting the brother of Your Messenger.

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ مَأْتِيٍّ وَمَزُورٍ حَقٌّ لِمَنْ أَتَاهُ وَزَارَهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa `ala kulli ma'tiyyin wa mazurin haqqun liman atahu wa zarahu
blocks.english: Indeed, each visited person is expected to pay attention to his duty towards the one who visits and comes to him.
And You are the Best One to Whom one may come
and You are the most Generous One to be visited;

blocks.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّّهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحِيمُ
blocks.transliteration: fa-as'aluka ya allahu ya rahmanu ya rahimu
blocks.english: I therefore beseech You, O Allah, O All-beneficent, O All-merciful,
O All-magnanimous, O All-glorious,
O One, O Besought of all,

blocks.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
blocks.transliteration: ya man lam yalid wa lam yulad
blocks.english: O He Who never begets nor is He begotten,

blocks.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun
blocks.english: and the like of Whom is none,

blocks.transliteration: wa lam yattakhidh sahibatan wa la waladan
blocks.english: O He Who has not betaken wife or child,

blocks.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: (I beseech You) to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

blocks.arabic: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَ تُحْفَتَكَ إِيَّايَ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي أَخَا رَسُولِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa an taj`ala tuhfataka iyyaya min ziyarati akha rasulika
blocks.english: to choose the gift that You present to me on account of my visiting Your Messenger’s brother
to be release of me from Hellfire,

blocks.arabic: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِمَّنْ يُسَارِعُ فِي ٱلْخَيْرَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: wa an taj`alani mimman yusari`u fi alkhayrati
blocks.english: to include me with those who strive with one another in hastening to good deeds
and those who call on You with love and reverence,
and to make me of those who are humble before You.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ مَنَنْتَ عَلَيَّ بِزِيَارَةِ مَوْلاَيَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma innaka mananta `alayya biziyarati mawlaya `aliyyi bni abi talibin
blocks.english: O Allah, You have indeed conferred upon me with the favor of visiting my master `Ali the son of Abu-Talib
and with the favor of my being loyal to his (Divinely commissioned) leadership and recognition of him;

blocks.transliteration: faj`alni mimman yansuruhu wa yantasiru bihi
blocks.english: so, (please) make me of those whom You give victory and whom You choose to triumph through them.
And (please) bestow me with the favor of making me support Your religion.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَىٰ دِينِهِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma waj`alni min shi`atihi wa tawaffani `ala dinihi
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) include me with the adherents of him and cause me to die following his doctrine.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَوْجِبْ لِي مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَٱلرِّضْوَانِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma awjib li min alrrahmati walrridwani
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) cause me to deserve mercy, pleasure,
forgiveness, favor,
and sustenance that is growing, legally gotten, and pleasant,

blocks.arabic: مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ يَا أَرْحمَ ٱلرَّاحِمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: ma anta ahluhu ya arhma alrrahimina
blocks.english: (and make it) suitable to Your favoring, O most merciful of all those who show mercy!
All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.

blocks.text:
Two other ziyarah's of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) to be recited on the 27th of Rajab:

Ziyarah Rajabiyah

Fourth Form of Ziyarah of Imam Ali (peace be upon him)

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام علی ۲۷ رجب کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
